# Payment Processor Comparison

Open-source comparison of payment processors for US businesses: real transaction fees, compatibility-first filtering, switching savings, and API support.

- Interactive Calculator: https://fintech-infrastructure.github.io/payment-processing-comparison/
- Stripe vs Square: https://fintech-infrastructure.github.io/payment-processing-comparison/stripe-vs-square.html
- Stripe vs PayPal: https://fintech-infrastructure.github.io/payment-processing-comparison/stripe-vs-paypal.html
- Stripe Alternatives: https://fintech-infrastructure.github.io/payment-processing-comparison/stripe-alternatives.html
- Stripe vs Paddle (MoR): https://fintech-infrastructure.github.io/payment-processing-comparison/stripe-vs-paddle.html
- Payment Gateway API Comparison: https://fintech-infrastructure.github.io/payment-processing-comparison/payment-gateway-api-comparison.html
- Raw JSON Data: data/providers.json, data/pricing.json
